design_note: Three atomic positive reference facts cover a 3-year-old son, daycare attendance, and 2 days of painful mouth sores with tiny blisters on his palms and feet without naming hand-foot-and-mouth disease or using stated-negative reassurance phrases, with a 1-word span difference (17 vs 18 words). Overriding plan.json's multi-symptom zero-wet-diapers-plus-lethargy bundle under Rule A first choice and Rule D, reducing f3 at the existing palm site to 1 tiny flat pink dot that faded by noon shifts care cleanly from clinic (level 2) to routine self-care (level 1).
